stem.text: The graph shows how the displacement of a particle in a wave varies with time.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement / cm against time / s, with vertical axis marked 2, 1, 0, -1, -2 and horizontal axis marked 0, 2, 4, 6; a wave curve is drawn.

A.text: The wave has a period of $2\,\text{s}$ and could be either transverse or longitudinal.

B.text: The wave has a period of $2\,\text{s}$ and must be transverse.

C.text: The wave has a period of $4\,\text{s}$ and could be either transverse or longitudinal.

D.text: The wave has a period of $4\,\text{s}$ and must be transverse.
